verdict.rationale: Latham's Emerging Companies & Growth practice page explicitly claims global reach across key venture hubs (Bay Area, Austin, Boston, London, Hong Kong, Singapore), connects investors with entrepreneurs, and advises on financings from seed to growth-stage, which supports cross-border investor/financing work. However, there is no specific documentation of redomiciliation/flip transactions or multi-jurisdiction financing mechanics, and no client-facing tooling (like LathamDrive) addresses cross-border structuring specifically. Missing for 10: explicit mention of flips/redomiciliations, jurisdiction-specific financing templates or guides, and any client testimonials/case studies of actual cross-border deals.
